brief.description: Two-man and three-man crews with a 26-foot truck for local moves in North Bay, Callander and Corbeil. We wrap furniture, disassemble beds, and carry insurance on the contents up to $50,000. We also do piano moves and storage-unit loads. Hourly rate with a three-hour minimum, and the clock starts when we arrive, not when we leave the yard. Book at least a week ahead in summer since students and new hires fill the calendar.
